D.t: Scott Peters leads by 42.3 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 109,332 votes; a one point swing is about 1,293 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +35.3 and D +49.1. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$2.6M cash against $4K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
